from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "application_metrics" and r.profile_name == "exp4")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.origin == "server")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cpu_m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scheme =~ /^${scheme}$/)
